say:0:1720961001:1.text: Demit used a fake public works project as cover while funneling newspaper funds into planks, rope, and other supplies to repair a boat. He even hired a boatman.
say:0:1720961001:1.source_cn: 德米特子爵一方面利用自己的职权杜撰了一项市政工程项目，...
say:0:1720961001:1.male: Demit used a fake public works project as cover while funneling newspaper funds into planks, rope, and other supplies to repair a boat. He even hired a boatman.
say:0:1720961001:1.female: Demit used a fake public works project as cover while funneling newspaper funds into planks, rope, and other supplies to repair a boat. He even hired a boatman.

say:1:1720961002:1.text: He was using the so-called public works project to cover what he was really doing: fixing up a boat so he could escape by water if things went south.
say:1:1720961002:1.source_cn: 他在以市政工程为名掩盖自己的行动——修缮船只，并在时机...
say:1:1720961002:1.male: He was using the so-called public works project to cover what he was really doing: fixing up a boat so he could escape by water if things went south.
say:1:1720961002:1.female: He was using the so-called public works project to cover what he was really doing: fixing up a boat so he could escape by water if things went south.

say:3:1720961003:1.text: Fixing a boat... hiring a boatman... getting out by boat! If that's the plan, then he needs a place to leave from...
say:3:1720961003:1.source_cn: 修船……招船工……乘船潜逃！那他一定需要一个地方出发……

say:5:1720961005:1.text: Exactly! The lower district dock. It's crowded, chaotic, and bustling with people who don't ask questions. If Demit wanted to disappear without drawing attention, that's where he'd go!
say:5:1720961005:1.source_cn: 没错！就是下城区的码头！那里势力交错，鱼龙混杂，最适合...

say:6:1720961006:1.text: Damn it... We locked down the roads and never stopped to think he might leave by river.
say:6:1720961006:1.source_cn: 该死……我们在陆路严加布防，却忽略了水路。

say:7:1720961007:1.text: Alright. We head for the dock right now. If we move fast, we may still catch him before he gets away!
say:7:1720961007:1.source_cn: 我们立刻动身前往下城区码头，或许还来得及在他离港前将他截住！
